description: Plan laser hair removal in {{laserLocations}} with Cutera excel HR. Explore face and body areas, pulse packages, skin assessment and aftercare.
answer: Laser hair removal uses pulses of light to reduce regrowth in suitable face or body areas. At {{brand}} in {{laserLocations}}, women and men can discuss individual areas, full-body treatment and pulse packages. Skin tone, hair colour and recent tanning help determine whether Cutera excel HR is appropriate.
preparation: Mention tanning, medications and previous reactions to laser. Ask how to prepare the area; light or grey hair may respond poorly.
howPerformed: After skin and hair assessment, suitable settings and eye protection are selected. The handpiece delivers pulses to the agreed area; a test area may be advised.
followup: Warmth or redness may follow. Protect the area from sun and contact the branch about blisters or lasting discomfort.
risks: Burns, irritation and darker or lighter patches can occur, especially after tanning or with unsuitable settings.

faqs.a: Pulses can feel hot or like a brief snap. Comfort varies by area.

faqs.q: How many visits might I need?
faqs.a: A course is usually discussed because hair grows in cycles. Six to eight sessions may be discussed, with the plan reviewed for each area and response.

faqs.q: Can I go back to my usual routine afterwards?
faqs.a: Warmth or redness may follow. Protect the area from sun and contact the branch about blisters or lasting discomfort.

faqs.q: Can I have treatment if my skin marks easily?
